after: A Rider of Rohan sent up from the Guardian reserve, mail-shirted and travel-stained, come to shore up the line along the Great North Road and the Gap. He fights from the saddle when he can, wheeling to spear an isolated foe, and dismounts to trade sword and shield blows when the press is too close for a horse.

You know these riders by their gilded mail and the horsetail plumes on their helms, marks of Edoras's finest. Mounted or afoot they fight with spear and long sword, driving hard, coordinated charges that break lesser lines before falling back to re-form.

Sharkey's ruffians left one of their own to skulk in his chamber -- Smithey the Sneak, a halfling gone bad among bigger and crueler men. He is no swordsman, favoring a knife in the ribs from behind or through a half-open door, and will duck and run rather than trade blows toe to toe.
